description: Use this to read answers people gave in a page's Inputs (thing:inputs collections). Publishers and editors see everyone's latest answers with names; pass mine to read only the user's own. Returns every page of results.

artifact.description: Artifact name, team/slug, or its link (a /v/N link pins that version)

history.description: Include earlier submissions, not just the latest per person

mine.description: Only the signed-in user's own answers

team.description: Team slug when the artifact name is ambiguous

name: list_artifact_responses
